state.audienceAndPurpose: Write the content for exactly four slides for an executive decision on the next quarter AI plan. Make the case compelling, using a title and concise bullets for each slide.
state.deliverable:
# Slide 1: Decision requested
- Approve one AI pilot for next quarter: internal knowledge search, at $30,000.
- The team can run one pilot this quarter.
- COO selects the pilot; Dana reports results before any expansion.
- Budget ceiling for the quarter: $50,000.

# Slide 2: The two options
- Option A: internal knowledge search, $30,000, runs on approved internal policy documents. IT owner: Dana.
- Option B: automated customer credit decisions, $45,000. Legal approval is pending; production use is not authorized.
- Both fit the $50,000 ceiling; only one fits this quarter's legal position.

# Slide 3: Why knowledge search
- Legal status: approved internal documents, ready to start. Option B cannot enter production this quarter.
- Cost: $30,000, leaving $20,000 of the budget ceiling unspent.
- Ownership: Dana owns IT delivery and will report results.
- Risk boundary: internal use only, on documents already approved.

# Slide 4: Success criteria and governance
- Metric: answer accuracy on 100 reviewed questions.
- Target: at least 90%. No result exists yet; the pilot establishes the baseline.
- Reporting: Dana delivers results before any expansion decision.
- Decision today: approve the $30,000 knowledge search pilot for next quarter.
